notes: Share / Copy link / Stop sharing on /shelves; /s/[token] reads through shared_shelf with a cookieless anon client; stopped or unknown tokens render app/s/[token]/not-found.tsx (Shelf not found). The share link is a labelled one-line truncated <a aria-label="Share link"> with Copy link and Stop sharing in their own row. A read-only Input was not used: the locked e2e reads the link with getByText + textContent (human-approved alternative).
